svg.title: MOSS-Image-Edit: tokens, time conditioning and reference KV cache
svg.desc: Text tokens come from the text encoder, reference tokens from clean VAE latents, and target tokens from noisy VAE latents. In sequence order text, ref, target, their modulation times are t, zero, t. All use shared Transformer weights. Reference queries only read reference keys and values. Text and target queries read all tokens. Each layer reference K/V is computed once and reused across denoising steps.

g.font-family: Inter, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
g.text: Token 来源、时间调制与逐层参考 KV 复用
时间调制用于 attention、MLP 与残差门控
ref 分支 t = 0 · 每层预计算一次
同一份逐层缓存，跨去噪步复用
不依赖当前目标状态与文本。
训练：仅 target 计算 V-loss
